from .bump import cmd_bump
from .check import cmd_check
from .compare import cmd_compare

def createparser():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('subcommand', choices=['pysemver', 'bump', 'check', 'compare'])
    subcommands = {
        'pysemver': cmd_pysemver,
        'bump': cmd_bump,
        'check': cmd_check,
        'compare': cmd_compare
    }
    parser.set_defaults(func=subcommands.get)
    return parser
